title: New Music Radar: rabbit, radikrill, Bigfoot Sighting and more
excerpt: How blessed are we to live in a world where there’s an endless supply of new music from the depths of every genre?
content:
Ride the new music wave.

How blessed are we to live in a world where there’s an endless supply of new music from the depths of every genre and the corners of every country?

There’s never too much of a good thing, but there’s a lot to discover out there in the sonic ocean.

If you don’t know where to start, here’s ten picks from us to you.

rabbit – ‘So It Goes’

Buzzing with indie-rock rock energy, this one is driven by some groovy tambourine percussion, sunny riffs and catchy hooks.

radikrill – ‘promise’

All the angsty vocal qualities you love about pop-punk, with some electronic and rock sounds thrown in to broaden your emo horizons.

Little Green – ‘Who Do You Love’

A tender ballad with layers of sweet melodies, supported simply by gentle acoustic guitar for soft listening.

annabelly – ‘FALL.IN.IN.LOVE’

Hazy indie-pop track with a glittering electronic production. Vocal distortion and a heartbeat bass makes it feel straight out of a dream.

Bigfoot Sighting – ‘Paper Plate Cartography’

4th wave emo is still kicking in 2026, and Bigfoot Sighting is leading the charge with twinkling riffs and vocals full of anguish. What’s not to love?

D1NG0 – ‘incomplete’

Starting soft with smooth melodies, this one builds to a dynamic track that blends rock riffs and catchy hooks that can’t sit still in one genre.

RAMZ – ‘liminal’

A future-nostalgia track that invites you to be introspective over delicate melodies and ambient instrumentals.

Taylor Clyde – ‘Reverie’

Soaring soul vocals take centre stage on this moving ballad, with haunting crescendos and elegant piano.

Ellise Hill – ‘in this with you’

A little bit of magic and a lot of sincerity woven into a lovely acoustic folk track, this one is easy on the ears and heavy on the heart.

ktfaithful – POP* IN MY <3

Colourful electronic production that’s bringing big emotions into a lightweight, bedroom-synth sound.
